text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm going to make some<n>refreshments
before training starts. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hmmm... I wonder what Trainer would<n>like.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, vegetables are cheap... But if I<n>want to cover
all the nutritional bases,<n>then I'll need some meat
too!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Actually, while I'm at it, I should try<n>cooking up a
new dish.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure there were a ton of<n>cookbooks at
the bookstore in the<n>mall.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I know! I should make something<n>that'll keep for a
while. I'll grab a<n>cookbook with tasty recipes that
can<n>be frozen, and—

text_block_list.name: PA Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Attention all shoppers! A limited-time<n>sale on meats
will be starting soon!<n>Act now before they're sold
out!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Goodness! I need to get some before<n>they sell out!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... I'm sure it'll be fine if I'm<n>only a tiny bit
late.
